targetWords.definition: An alien is a creature from a different world.
targetWords.example: The alien came in peace.

targetWords.definition: If you are among certain things, they are all around you.
targetWords.example: ■There was a red apple among the green ones.

targetWords.definition: A chart is a list of information.
targetWords.example: We used a chart to see how we had improved.

targetWords.definition: A cloud is a group of water drops in the sky.
targetWords.example: ■The sky was filled with white clouds.

targetWords.definition: To comprehend something is to understand it.
targetWords.example: ■Henry could not comprehend the message.

targetWords.definition: To describe is to say or write what someone or something is like.
targetWords.example: They described their tree as colorful with gold ribbon and a star.

targetWords.definition: Ever means at any time.
targetWords.example: Going skiing last winter was the most fun I've ever had.

targetWords.definition: To fail means you do not succeed in what you try to do.
targetWords.example: Since he failed to get the job, he was sad.

targetWords.definition: Friendly is behaving in a pleasant, kind way toward someone.
targetWords.example: The friendly animals came up to the girl.

targetWords.definition: A grade is a score or mark given to someone's work.
targetWords.example: ■I managed to get good grades on my report card. \ 3

targetWords.definition: Instead means in place of.
targetWords.example: •He ate the carrot instead of the ice cream.

targetWords.definition: A library is a place where you go to read books.
targetWords.example: •The library at school is full of books.

targetWords.definition: A planet is a large round thing in space.
targetWords.example: Saturn is the planet with the ring around it.

targetWords.definition: A report is something students write for school.
targetWords.example: Karen had trouble writing her report.

targetWords.definition: Several is more than two but not many.
targetWords.example: •He had to read several books for class.

targetWords.definition: To solve something is to find an answer to it.
targetWords.example: All the students could easily solve the math problem. JL I

targetWords.definition: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.
targetWords.example: I was suddenly surprised by the cake my friends brought me.

targetWords.definition: To suppose is to guess.
targetWords.example: •I suppose I should go home now.

targetWords.definition: The universe is the known or supposed objects in space.
targetWords.example: The universe is so large that it cannot be measured.

targetWords.definition: To view is to look at something.
targetWords.example: Michael likes to view himself in the mirror. )

story.title: The Report
story.passage:
Lee sat among the books at the library and thought about his group project.

They had to turn it in soon, but he hadn't even started his part! Jack and Claire

were in his group. They had worked hard. They were also very smart, and Lee

didn't want them to get a bad grade.

Jack did the report. He wrote a lot of very good sentences and described things

with great adjectives. Claire drew a nice map of the stars. Now, Lee needed to do

his part of the project.

"Well, I suppose I need to start my model," Lee thought.

Making a model of a planet was really hard. Lee tried to read several books,

but he couldn't comprehend any of the charts. "We're going to fail because of

me!" Lee said. He put his head down on the table and said, " I wish I could see a

planet, instead of having to read about it!"

Suddenly, there was a bright light. Lee was pulled from his chair, through the

roof, and right into a strange ship! " Hello, kid," said an alien. " Did you ask for

help?"

Lee told the friendly alien all about his project. The alien agreed to help Lee

solve his problem. " First, we'll fly through space to view the universe. Then, I can

help you make a model of my planet."

Soon, they were going through the clouds. They passed the moon. Then they

viewed Mars. Lee was very excited. Instead of a bad grade, his group would have

the best project ever!

" It's time to go home," the alien finally said. On the way back, he helped Lee

make a model of the planet

Mars. Soon, they were on

Earth.

"Thanks," Lee said.

" My model will be

awesome!" Then he

took his model and

said goodbye to his

new friend.
